visual_brief.subject: Rescale uses an AI agent to triage failed tests before engineers approve releases
verified_context: Rescale now uses an AI agent for the first pass on failed nightly tests that gate its weekly releases.
Engineers review its diagnosis and recommendations; deployment authority stays with people.
visual_brief.editorial_idea: Show automated sorting and evidence gathering ending at a separate human-controlled release gate.
visual_brief.visual_metaphor: sorted failure channels, a terracotta evidence tray and a guarded release gate
must_show: sorted failure channels, a terracotta evidence tray and a guarded release gate

candidate_notes.A: Constitution-compliant physical triage workbench; human hands make the composition busier at card size.
candidate_notes.B: Selected replacement: three stepped sorting/evidence areas and a separate latched gate form a clean, compact artifact study.
candidate_notes.C: Constitution-compliant but the literal reviewers and landscape weaken the abstract editorial focus.

crop_review.article_desktop: Centered 21:9 crop retains sorting recesses, terracotta tray and the separate gate latch; top edges may crop without losing the relationship.
crop_review.article_mobile: Full 16:9 crop retains the complete focal grouping.
crop_review.thumbnail: 320px 3:2 crop retains tray, sorting areas and gated review boundary.

golden_reference_comparison: Compared references-first with the declared plugin and review-control artwork. Selected B shares warm stone materiality, deliberate geometry, restrained brass/terracotta and a distinct small-scale silhouette. The metaphor is an artifact study, not a purported CI architecture.

A.prompt: Placement: article hero. Output crop: wide 16:9, high-resolution 1600x900 or larger. Verified context: Rescale now uses an AI agent for the first pass on failed nightly tests that gate its weekly releases. Engineers review its diagnosis and recommendations; deployment authority stays with people. Visual idea: a physical triage workbench sorts abstract failed-test signals into evidence-backed queues before a separate guarded release gate, a metaphor rather than system architecture. Composition A canonical: slightly elevated oblique view of a solid stone workbench with three shallow channels holding irregular dark tokens, a broad terracotta evidence tray in the central foreground, and a compact manually latched gate immediately behind the tray; one focal grouping, cream paper terrain, fine ink shading. No conveyor belts or generic gears. Art direction: restrained contemporary editorial illustration with quiet scientific and architectural sensibility, deliberate geometry, fine supporting lines, subtle paper print texture, warm canvas #F3EBDD, paper #FAF6EE, near-black ink #171B1A, muted gray #575D5B, sparing terracotta #8A4B35. Spacious composition, strong contrast. Keep all essential parts within the central two thirds and middle half vertically so the idea survives 21:9 desktop object-fit cover, 16:9 mobile and 320px card crops. No words, letters, numbers, labels, logos, interface elements, page header, footer, buttons, badges, charts with invented data, watermark, neon effects, robots, or generic glowing AI brains. generation_metadata.visual_review: Each candidate inspected individually for constitutional failures before scoring. Three viable compositions compared against two golden references and inspected in desktop, mobile and 320px crops. Initial Rescale B rejected for pseudo-text and replaced.
generation_metadata.contact_sheet_method: Repository Playwright CLI attempted but the browser executable was unavailable and its download returned truncated archives. Equivalent references-first contact sheets and crop sheets built with Pillow, then inspected directly.

rejected_candidates.reason: Pseudo-text on the paper in the evidence tray; rejected before scoring.
